changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE "${schema}".payroll_unpaid_leave_policy ( tenant_id UUID PRIMARY KEY, enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, basic_component_code VARCHAR(64), day_divisor NUMERIC(10,4), treatment VARCHAR(24), updated_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES "${schema}"."user"(id), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT chk_unpaid_policy_divisor CHECK (day_divisor IS NULL OR day_divisor > 0), CONSTRAINT chk_unpaid_policy_treatment CHECK (treatment IS NULL OR treatment IN ('BEFORE_STATUTORY','AFTER_STATUTORY')), CONSTRAINT chk_unpaid_policy_enabled CHECK (NOT enabled OR ( basic_component_code IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(BTRIM(basic_component_code)) > 0 AND day_divisor IS NOT NULL AND treatment IS NOT NULL )) ); CREATE TABLE "${schema}".payroll_unpaid_leave_allocation ( leave_request_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES "${schema}".leave_request(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, employee_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES "${schema}".employee(id), from_date DATE NOT NULL, to_date DATE NOT NULL, approved_days NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL CHECK (approved_days > 0), date_units JSONB NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CHECK (to_date >= from_date) ); ALTER TABLE "${schema}".payslip ADD CONSTRAINT uq_payslip_unpaid_tenant_id UNIQUE (tenant_id,id); CREATE TABLE "${schema}".payslip_unpaid_leave ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, payslip_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, basic_component_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, basic_amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (basic_amount >= 0), day_divisor NUMERIC(10,4) NOT NULL CHECK (day_divisor > 0), unpaid_days NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unpaid_days >= 0), amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount >= 0), treatment VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL CHECK (treatment IN ('BEFORE_STATUTORY','AFTER_STATUTORY')), source_days JSONB NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT fk_unpaid_snapshot_payslip FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,payslip_id) REFERENCES "${schema}".payslip(tenant_id,id) ON DELETE RESTRICT );
